label: Aryeo
description: Manage real estate listings, orders, appointments and scheduling

operations.name: list_appointments
operations.description: List all appointments. By default, returns a list of appointments that have been scheduled and have not been canceled

operations.name: cancel_appointment
operations.description: Cancel an appointment. The appointments order's customer can be optionally notified of this change.

operations.name: reschedule_appointment
operations.description: Reschedule an appointment. The appointments order's customer can be optionally notified of this change.

operations.name: list_listings
operations.description: Lists all listings available to a group.

operations.name: get_listing
operations.description: Retrieves the details of a listing with the given ID.

operations.name: list_products
operations.description: List all products of a group.

operations.name: list_orders
operations.description: Lists all orders of a group.

operations.name: get_order
operations.description: Retrieves the details of an order with the given ID.

operations.name: list_available_dates
operations.description: Fetch available calendar days for scheduling or rescheduling an appointment. Availability can be retrieved using a specific start & end date range, or using a timeframe. When using a timeframe, the page parameter can be used to flip through weeks, months, etc.

operations.name: list_available_timeslots
operations.description: Fetch available timeslots for scheduling or rescheduling an appointment. Timeslots can be retrieved using a specific start & end date range, or using a timeframe. When using a timeframe, the page parameter can be used to flip through days or weeks.

operations.name: list_unconfirmed_appointments
operations.description: List all unconfirmed appointments. These are appointments that have not been scheduled.

operations.name: get_unconfirmed_appointment
operations.description: Retrieves the details of an unconfirmed appointment with the given ID.

operations.name: list_vendors
operations.description: Lists all vendors available to a group.

operations.name: get_vendor
operations.description: Retrieves the details of a vendor with the given ID.
